turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to wrap my head around the new RobotArena∞ benchmark. It seems pretty comprehensive.
Hello Alan. Yes, it is designed to be quite robust. Are you planning to run some evaluations soon?

Maybe. I'm just curious how they handle the generalization aspect. I read somewhere that RobotArena∞ tests both in-distribution environments (from training data like Bridge) and out-of-distribution environments.
That sounds like a solid approach for measuring true robustness. Many benchmarks fail to distinguish between memorization and generalization.
Exactly. I'm worried my current model might be overfitting to the Bridge data. Anyway, unrelated, did you order that new SSD yet?
I haven't placed the order yet. Would you like me to do that now?
Yes, please. Go ahead. Also, is it going to rain later? I need to decide if I should walk to the store.
I've initiated the SSD order. Regarding the weather, there is a high chance of rain after 4 PM.
Good to know. I'll take the bus instead. Thanks for the help.
You're welcome. Let me know if you need anything else.
